newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsumi Elec up in afternoon on DVD hopes.
newsitem.headline: Mitsumi Elec up in afternoon on DVD hopes.

text.p: Shares in Mitsumi Electric Co Ltd were higher in early afternoon trade on Tuesday as investors who believe the future is bright for digital video discs (DVD) bought the shares, brokers said.
As of 0414 GMT, the shares were 90 yen higher at 2,050 yen with a turnover of 2.249 million shares, the eighth-largest volume in the first section.
Some brokers said speculation that the company's earnings, which have yet to be announced, may show an improvement was also stirring up interest in the shares.
"Of the electric company shares, Mitsumi is a favourite among speculative investor circles and therefore it is relatively easy to buy," one broker said.
